nodes.body: The block reason text says to upgrade to "1.0.83-4 or later", but the code/tests treat stable "1.0.83" (no prerelease) as safe too; this wording can mislead users into thinking 1.0.83 stable is still affected.

Fixed in d0365fb81ab5f3de0db804ca1f1be5cf3b3d7230, clarified the block reason to distinguish Copilot CLI 1.0.83 stable from affected prereleases and added assertions for both stable and prerelease upgrade guidance.

`provider_disable_pending()` hardcodes an English error detail ("the provider has not acknowledged…"), which will appear untranslated for all non-en-US locales because only the surrounding `system.config_update_failed` template is localized (see tools/wta/locales/en-US.yml:136). Consider moving this detail into a localized string key (e.g. `system.yolo_disable_pending_reason`) and passing `t!(...)` here, similar to how `publish_retryable_lazy_yolo_error` localizes its `error` argument via `setup.option.retry_detection`.
